finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `node --check` passes on every file.

Two things I left alone:

| Left | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` 2 calls | File header says do not edit. Wholesale replaced on upgrade. |
| `cache.query(...)` 22 calls | Different API. Takes a cache key, not SQL. |

The vendor calls still hit the deprecated path. Fix needs an upstream bump or a wrapper.
